title: The JAMMU AND KASHMIR FINANCE COMMISSION FOR PANCHAYATS AND MUNICIPALITIES ACT, 2011
full_text: The JAMMU AND KASHMIR FINANCE COMMISSION FOR PANCHAYATS AND MUNICIPALITIES ACT, 2011 Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 201116 Act Number: 16 Enactment Date: 2011-04-23 Act Year: 2011 Short Title: The JAMMU AND KASHMIR FINANCE COMMISSION FOR PANCHAYATS AND MUNICIPALITIES ACT, 2011 Long Title: An Act to provide for constitution of a State Finance Commission to review the financial position of the Panchayats, Municipalities and suggesting measures thereof and matters connected therewith or incidental thereto. Department: Department of Rural Development and Panchayati Raj Enforcement Date: 25-04-2011 Type: STATE Location: Jammu and Kashmir TitleFiles TitleFiles TitleFiles TitleFiles Show all section Section 1. Short title and commencement. Section 2. Definitions. Section 3. Constitution of the Finance Commission for Panchayats and Municipalities. Section 4. Term of office of Chairperson and Members. Section 5. Member to act as Chairperson or to discharge his functions in certain circumstances. Section 6. Removal of Chairperson and Members. Section 7. Vacancies etc. not to invalidate the proceedings of the Commission. Section 8. Procedures to be regulated by the Commission. Section 9. Office and other staff of the Commission. Section 10. Functions of the Commission. Section 11. Power to call for information and documents. Section 12. Report of the Commission. Section 13. Grants by the Government. Section 14. Accounts and audit of the Commission. Section 15. Members and officers to be public servants. Section 16. Protection of action taken in good faith. Section 17. Powers of the Government to make rules. Section 18. Power to remove difficulties.
